questions.q_en: Rice worth ₹43/kg and ₹67/kg are mixed with a third variety in the ratio 2:1:5. If the mixture is worth ₹96/kg, the price (in ₹) of the third variety of rice per kg will be:
questions.solution_en:
Let price of the third variety of rice per kg = ₹p

The ratio of 1st, 2nd and third variety of rice per kg = 2:1:5

Now,

2*43 + 1*67 + 5*p = (2 + 1 + 5) *96

86 + 67 + 5p = 8*96

153 + 5p = 768

5p = 615

p = ₹123

questions.q_en: If the average of 80 numbers M1, M2, M3, ......, M80 is M, then find the average of the numbers M1 + 20, M2 + 20, M3 + 20, .........., M80 + 20.
questions.solution_en:
M1 + M2 + M3 + ...... + M80 = 80M

[(M1 + 20) + (M2 + 20) + (M3 + 20) + ...... + (M80 + 20)]/80

= (80M + 20*80)/80

= M + 20

Express method -

If the average of some numbers is 'a' and a number 'b' is added/subtracted/multiplied/divide to each number, then the new average becomes (a+b)/(a-b)/ab/(a/b) respectively.

So, the average of the numbers M1 + 20, M2 + 20, M3 + 20, .........., M80 + 20 = M + 20

questions.q_en: A can do 4/5th of the work in 48 hours, B can do half of the work in 20 hours while C can do 33(1/3)% of the work in 10 hours. All of them started the work together, A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. Find the total time taken to complete the work.
questions.solution_en:
33(1/3) means (33 + 1/3) od (100/3).

A = 48 * 5/4 = 60 hours

B = 20 * 2 = 40 hours

C = 10 * 100/(100/3) = 30 hours

A and B left 6 hours and 4 hours before the completion of the work respectively. This means C alone worked for last 4 hours while B and C together worked for 2 hours before that time. So,

Part of work done by C in 4 hours = 4/30 = 2/15

Part of work done by B and C together in 2 hours = 2 * (1/30 + 1/40) = 7/60

So, remaining work (which is done by A, B and C together) = 1 - 2/15 - 7/60 = 3/4

Let A, B and C together completed 3/4 part of the work in t hours. Now,

t = (3/4) * 1/(1/60 + 1/40 + 1/30)

t = (3/4) * 120/9

t = 10

Therefore, total time taken to complete the work = 10 + 2 + 4 = 16 hours

questions.q_en: Three cards are drawn one after another with replacement from a pack of cards. What is the probability of getting first card a Jack, second card a black card, and third card an even numbered card?
questions.solution_en:
Probability of drawing a Jack from a pack of cards = 4/52 = 1/13

Probability of drawing a black card from a pack of cards = 26/52 = 1/2

Probability of drawing an even numbered card from a pack of cards = 20/52 = 5/13

Required probability = 1/13 * ½ * 5/13

= 5/338
questions.solution_hi:

Probability of drawing a black card from a pack of cards = 26/52 = 1/2

Probability of drawing an even numbered card from a pack of cards = 20/52 = 5/13

Required probability = 1/13 * ½ * 5/13

= 5/338

questions.q_en: Pipe X can fill a tank in 60 hours while pipe Y can fill the tank in 72 hours. Both pipes are opened together for 20 hours. How much of the tank is left empty?
questions.solution_en:
Capacity of tank = LCM of 60 and 72 = 360 units

Efficiency of pipe X = 360/60 = 6 units/hours

Efficiency of pipe Y = 360/72 = 5 units/hours

Part of tank got filled in 20 hours = (6 + 5) * 20 = 220 units

Part of tank left empty = 140/360 = 7/18
questions.solution_hi:

A boat can cover 352 km in still water in 11 hours and it can cover 192 km in upstream and 180 km in downstream in total of 12.5 hours. What is the upstream speed of the boat?
questions.solution_en:
Speed of boat in still water = 352/11 = 32 km/h

Let speed of stream is x km/h

According to the question,

=> x = 8 km/h

Upstream speed of the boat = 32 - 8 = 24 km/h

questions.q_en: The respective ratio of the initial number of notebooks A has to that of B has, is 2: 3. And the respective ratio of the number of notebooks sold by A to that of by B is 3: 4. If the number of notebooks sold by B is 80% of the number of initial notebooks A has, then find the ratio of the number of notebooks left with A to that of with B.
questions.solution_en:
Let initial number of notebooks A has = 2X

And initial number of notebooks B has = 3X

And number of notebooks sold by A = 3Y

And number of notebooks sold by B = 4Y

ATQ,

4Y = 2X *4/5

5Y = 2X

Number of notebooks left with A = 2X - 3Y = 5Y - 3Y = 2Y

Number of notebooks left with B = 3X - 4Y = (15Y/2) - 4Y = 7Y/2

Required ratio = 2Y: (7Y/2) = 4: 7.

Weight of metal A in 44 kg of alloy = 44 * 9/22 = 18 kgs

Weight of metal B in 44 kg in alloy = 44 - 18 = 26 kgs

Hence, the cost of alloy = 800 * 18 + 650 * 26

= 14400 + 16900

= Rs. 31300
